purpose: Guides that cannot be accepted without a resource outside this environment. Each entry names the missing resource, where it plugs in, and the one action that unblocks it. Do not retry these guides until the resource exists.

missingResources.resource: A Nine Minds-signed license JWT bound to the sponsor tenant 24ac76c8-df59-4b10-8371-c56222904580 (aud = that tenant, tier 'pro', future exp, co_managed_seats = N), on a self-hosted installation that has a license_state row
missingResources.why: Only public verification keys are in the repository (packages/licensing/src/lib/license-keys.ts); seat capacity is read from claims.co_managed_seats only for a matching aud and tier 'pro' (packages/licensing/src/lib/co-managed-license.ts, co-managed-entitlements.ts).
missingResources.unblock: As the sponsor administrator on the self-hosted installation, open /msp/licenses, paste the signed token into #license-manual-key and click #license-activate-manual-key.

missingResources.resource: A real Stripe test account with a co-managed seat price, owned by the release owner
missingResources.why: The hosted purchase path uses the Stripe simulator while STRIPE_API_BASE_URL is set (ee/server/src/lib/stripe/stripeApiOverride.ts); real receipts need real Stripe keys.
missingResources.unblock: Set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_CO_MANAGED_USER_PRICE_ID and MASTER_BILLING_TENANT_ID, unset STRIPE_API_BASE_URL, restart the review app, then buy one seat from the client's seats dialog.

guides.alreadyVerified: Hosted simulator purchase, allocation, usage floor, lost-response reload and explicit same-operation replay (one receipt; pool 19), recorded on 1b9b112749 / build-1792941614066. Not re-run in this pass, as ordered.

missingResources.resource: A Pro license signed for the restored destination tenant (aud = destination tenant UUID, tier 'pro') on a self-hosted destination with a license_state row; or, for hosted, exactly one active paid PSA Stripe subscription whose metadata.tenant_id is the destination tenant
missingResources.why: Activation checks activateTenantPsaLicense / retainTenantPsaLicense (packages/licensing/src/lib/tenant-license-state.ts) or retainHostedPsaUpgradeCandidate + paidPsaUpgradeFromStripe (packages/licensing/src/lib/hosted-psa-upgrade.ts, ee/server/src/lib/stripe/coManagedIndependentEntitlement.ts); the hosted check reads Stripe directly, so the simulator cannot satisfy it.
missingResources.unblock: From server/: npm exec -- tsx --tsconfig ../ee/server/tsconfig.json scripts/restore-portable-workspace.ts --activate --destination-tenant <restored-uuid> --operation-id <retained-uuid> --license-file /abs/pro-license.jwt (hosted: --activate-hosted with the same tenant and operation flags).

guides.inReachNotBlocked: Inspecting a current export archive needs no external resource: scripts/restore-portable-workspace.ts --inspect --archive /abs/backup.alga (passphrase from a hidden prompt or --passphrase-stdin) prints sourceTenant, packageId, sha256 and eligible administrators. It was not run in this pass.
guides.alreadyVerified: Browser export and the paid-entitlement denial, recorded on 1b9b112749 / build-1792941614066.

missingResources.resource: An approved Microsoft Entra app registration (client ID, directory ID, client secret, admin consent) with a redirect URI on a publicly reachable base URL, plus an inbound mailbox the Graph subscription can notify
missingResources.why: Sign-in, mail and directory use real Microsoft endpoints unless MICROSOFT_GRAPH_BASE_URL / MICROSOFT_LOGIN_BASE_URL point at the emulator; production disables the SSO emulator (packages/auth/src/lib/sso/microsoftSsoEmulator.ts). Graph change notifications post to NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL / NEXTAUTH_URL, which must be reachable from the internet.
missingResources.unblock: As the customer administrator open /msp/co-management/providers, choose #provider-credentials-microsoft-tab, click #microsoft-settings-add-profile, fill #microsoft-profile-client-id, #microsoft-profile-tenant-id and #microsoft-profile-client-secret, tick email and msp_sso, and click #microsoft-profile-save.

missingResources.resource: Directory provisioning (SCIM) enabled for the customer tenant
missingResources.why: The user-provisioning tab is hidden unless the PostHog flag skim-support-feature is on (Enterprise edition).
missingResources.unblock: Enable skim-support-feature for the tenant, then /msp/security-settings?tab=user-provisioning → #create-scim-connection-button.

guides.alreadyVerified: Isolated provider forms, route boundaries and one actual SMTP-sink requester notification, recorded on 1b9b112749 / build-1792941614066.
